"Lithium-ion (Li-ion)",182.50,638.75,3.50,90,0.0808,"115-350","Assumptions: discount rate 7% (real), median lifespan 12.5 years → CRF=0.1226; cycles assumed 1 full cycle/day (365 cycles/yr); capex_per_kW computed as capex_per_kWh × median_duration_hours; O&M median $14.5/kW-yr (from sources). LCOC formula used: LCOC = (CRF·CAPEX_per_kW + O&M_per_kWyr) / (hours·cycles_per_yr·efficiency) which simplifies capex term to (CRF·capex_per_kWh)/(cycles·eff). Sensitivities computed: capex ±50% and duration ×0.5 / ×2.","Sources: BNEF (pack price $115/kWh, 2024) — pack/cell price not full installed system; PNNL 2022 (system-level ranges: 150-350 $/kWh energy CAPEX; 300-450 $/kW power CAPEX; lifespan ~10-15 yr; O&M reported $8-25/kW-yr).","Numeric summary: Median capex energy = $182.50/kWh; using median duration 3.50 h → capex power = $638.75/kW. Median efficiency 90%. With r=7% and life=12.5 yr (CRF=0.1226) and 365 cycles/yr, annualized capex contribution = $0.0681/kWh, O&M contribution = $0.0126/kWh; total median LCOC = $0.0808/kWh (80.8 $/MWh). Sensitivities: capex -50% → LCOC $0.0467/kWh; capex +50% → $0.1148/kWh. Duration halved (1.75 h) → LCOC $0.0934/kWh; duration doubled (7.0 h) → LCOC $0.0744/kWh. Note: PNNL reported LCOS $200-400/MWh under different assumptions (degradation, replacements, lower cycles)."
"Supercapacitors / Ultra-capacitors",3000.00,451.50,0.1505,90,0.0130,">1000 (represented 1000-5000)","Assumptions: energy CAPEX labeled >>1000 $/kWh in sources — for analysis represented range 1000–5000 $/kWh (median 3000 $/kWh) due to missing numeric precision; discount rate 7%, median lifespan 25 yr → CRF=0.0858; capex_per_kW = capex_per_kWh × median_duration_hours. Cycles assumed 100 cycles/day (36,500 cycles/yr) to reflect high-frequency utility use cases; O&M median $25.5/kW-yr. LCOC formula as above. Sensitivities computed for capex ±50% and duration ×0.5/×2.","Sources: Utility Dive (DOE summary) and PNNL project notes: describe supercapacitors as having very high $/kWh energy CAPEX but excellent power capability and cycle life; typical duration sub-minute to minutes; O&M ranges wide.","Numeric summary: Representative median energy capex $3,000/kWh; median duration 0.1505 h (≈9.03 min) → capex power = $451.50/kW. Median efficiency 90%. With r=7% and life=25 yr (CRF=0.0858) and 36,500 cycles/yr, annualized capex contribution = $0.00784/kWh, O&M contribution = $0.00516/kWh; total median LCOC ≈ $0.0130/kWh (13.0 $/MWh). Sensitivities: capex -50% → LCOC $0.0091/kWh; capex +50% → $0.0249/kWh. Duration halved → LCOC $0.0182/kWh; duration doubled → $0.0104/kWh. Important caveats: results highly sensitive to assumed cycles/yr and the represented energy-capex range — if cycles/yr are much lower (e.g., 1–10/day), LCOC per kWh rises sharply."
"}

{"filepath": "cost_vs_duration_scatter.svg", "content": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg width="700" height="420" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 420">
  <style> .axis{stroke:#333;stroke-width:1} .label{font-family:Arial;font-size:12px;fill:#222} .pt{font-family:Arial;font-size:11px;fill:#000} </style>
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#fff"/>
  <!-- Axes -->
  <g transform="translate(60,30)">
    <line x1="0" y1="350" x2="580" y2="350" class="axis"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="350" x2="0" y2="0" class="axis"/>
    <!-- X ticks (Duration hours, log-friendly scale shown linearly for clarity) -->
    <!-- We'll plot x from 0 to 8 hours (most points within) -->
    <text x="290" y="385" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Duration (hours)</text>
    <text transform="rotate(-90)" x="-175" y="-40" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Energy CAPEX (USD per kWh)</text>
    <!-- ticks -->
    <g class="label">
      <text x="0" y="370">0</text>
      <text x="116" y="370">1</text>
      <text x="232" y="370">2</text>
      <text x="348" y="370">3</text>
      <text x="464" y="370">4</text>
      <text x="580" y="370">8</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Y axis ticks -->
    <!-- We'll map y from 0..3500 USD/kWh to 350..0 px -->
    <g class="label">
      <text x="-48" y="350">0</text>
      <text x="-60" y="265">500</text>
      <text x="-60" y="180">1000</text>
      <text x="-60" y="95">2000</text>
      <text x="-60" y="10">3000</text>
    </g>
    <!-- helper transform: map data to pixel: x_pixel = duration_hours * scale_x; scale_x = 580/8 =72.5 -->
    <!-- y_pixel = 350 - (capex/3500)*350 -->
    <!-- Points -->
    <!-- Li-ion: duration 3.5h, capex 182.5 -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="{cx_li}" cy="{cy_li}" r="5" fill="#1f77b4"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Supercapacitor: duration 0.1505h, capex 3000 -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="{cx_sc}" cy="{cy_sc}" r="5" fill="#ff7f0e"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Labels (placed near points) -->
    <text x="{cx_li_plus}" y="{cy_li_plus}" class="pt">Li-ion (182.5 $/kWh, 3.5 h)</text>
    <text x="{cx_sc_plus}" y="{cy_sc_plus}" class="pt">Supercap (3,000 $/kWh, 0.15 h)</text>
  </g>
</svg>"}
